data.body: **[P1] Propagate fatal plugin failures through `DurableExecutor`.** Although `createPlugins` rethrows `VirtualMachineError` and `ThreadDeath`, this call runs inside `CompletableFuture.supplyAsync`; the future captures those throwables and the executor’s generic failure branch converts them into a normal durable failure. In particular, this suppresses `ThreadDeath` and lets the worker continue. After unwrapping handler failures, finalize any created plugins and rethrow fatal causes instead of building a failure output; add an end-to-end test through `DurableExecutor`.
